answer_1.quote: Given an input program, the formal specification inference task is to annotate the program with a set of formal specifications ... We conduct an extensive empirical study evaluating eight state-of-the-art LLMs on FormalBench-Base ...
answer_1.outputs: JML formal specifications (annotations) generated for Java programs

answer_2.quote: We define two consistency metrics as follows: (1) Success Rate (SR)... (2) Failure Rate (FR)... Completeness Metrics... we compute the fraction of these mutants that fail to satisfy the specification. This fraction is defined as the Completeness Rate (CR)... Robustness Metrics... we measure the Flip Rate (FlR)...

answer_4.quote: Our metric aligned with human evaluations: annotators labeled 8 of 20 LLM-generated specifications as complete and 12 as incomplete. For the latter, they selected the more complete specification in 66 pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each generated specification as complete or incomplete and, for pairs of specifications, to select the more complete one.
